prior_summary: Height-separated waypoint hierarchy: an eight-step auxiliary pose/duration diffusion with learned phase-conditioned progress produces four local role-relative TCP/requested-object knots. Smooth bounded interpolation conditions the standard learned actuator-action DDPM. Soft prediction-dependent geometry losses favor separated approach, empty retreat/travel, and loaded lift regimes while exempting predecessor lowering.
applicable_conditions: Unobstructed tabletop transfers with downward TCP and near-upright cubes, retaining world Z, absolute robot configuration and the demonstrated red-first then blue order. Covers the entire assigned expanded slice: initial empty approach; predecessor goal-aligned held descent, release and retreat; high retargeting; source approach, closure and full lift into early transport. There is no explicit caller role token: red goal-XY alignment is used to identify blue as the requested block, including before red release.
termination_guidance: Use observed requested-object height near the demonstrated 0.28 m carrying region, stable TCP/object relation and causal co-motion, fingers near 0.0183 m each and continuing grasp-maintaining action as readiness cues. Small goalward displacement supports transfer but is not a required threshold. A geometric TCP waypoint alone is not sufficient. Delivery can take over earlier in the shared pickup/lift overlap; pass current observations rather than a stale waypoint list. Task success remains the supplied red_at_goal AND blue_at_goal contract, without an added release or clearance condition.
limitations: Local future labels cover at most 16 action slots, so this is a receding arc-time waypoint hierarchy rather than a complete long-horizon event planner. Its geometric diffusion uses deterministic posterior-mean decoding; the final actions use the unchanged 100-step stochastic DDPM. No IK, FK, obstacle model, images, hard safety guarantee, arbitrary caller role order, or corrective regrasp competence is claimed. Predicted geometry is a learned conditioning signal, not verified robot kinematics. Phase labels are weak geometric labels, not contact measurements.

config.architecture: Four-knot geometric diffusion and conditional action U-Net
config.coverage: All 24 supplied expanded slices, unchanged, including all shared transition samples
config.normalization: Unchanged shared complete-demonstration normalizer; relative Cartesian features use shared TCP axis half ranges
config.role_association: Request blue when current red XY lies within 0.075 m of its own goal XY, otherwise request red; infer association only, never an action
config.waypoint_content: TCP position and wxyz quaternion, requested-object position and wxyz quaternion, log duration relative to four sample intervals
config.waypoint_xy_frame: Learned bridge-phase mixture of predecessor-pad and requested-object XY anchors
config.waypoint_z_frame: World Z with the shared TCP Z affine scale
config.waypoint_targets: Masked cumulative arc-time quartiles within available future slots; invalid or repeated knots are masked
config.geometric_diffusion_schedule: Cosine auxiliary schedule with beta capped at 0.999
config.geometric_diffusion_training: Conditional clean-pose regression at random noise levels plus rollout and interpolated-trajectory supervision
config.geometric_diffusion_decoding: Eight deterministic DDPM posterior-mean updates from zero Gaussian mean, recomputed from live causal history
config.interpolator: Current-pose-anchored piecewise convex cubic smoothstep; positive learned durations
config.reference_training: Primary causal predicted reference plus a second tracker loss on masked future references with 0.02 normalized pose noise and 0.04 log-duration noise
